top_headline: العنوان: القاهرة للدواجن (POUL.CA) دعوة الجمعية العامة غير العادية المقرر انعقادها في 30/11/2026 في تمام الساعة 03:00 مساءًاسم الشركة: القاهرة ل - معلومات مباشر
llm_summary:
- Cairo Poultry's stock has seen a significant drop, with a 38.3% decline in nine-month profits.
- The company's shares led the decline in the Egyptian stock market, with a 17% drop, reaching 8.30 Egyptian pounds.
- This decline has positioned Cairo Poultry as the most negatively impacted stock in the market.
- The small and medium-sized company index also fell by over 2%, influenced by the drop in Cairo Poultry's shares.
- Despite a revenue increase, the company's standalone net income rose over the same period.
- The stock's price movement has been allowed to fluctuate by 35.19% downwards, with a temporary halt set at 27.09%.
- Shareholders have until the end of today's session to claim the cash distribution of 1.89 Egyptian pounds per share.
- Cairo Poultry's overall profits for the first nine months of 2026 were 1.43 billion Egyptian pounds, a 39.1% decrease from the previous year.
